full_judgment: 8. Leave was granted to review the said judgment of this Court on two points :-(f) the High Court Divisions finding on the question of settlement is a finding of fact upon reversal of the finding of the lower appellate Court which is the final court of facts and this Division ignored its own established practice in this regard by accepting the finding of the High Court Division and (ii) that the Notification dated 13th April 1955 under the Forests Act, 1927 and the Notification dated 6th May, 1954 under the Private Forests Ordinance 1949 have not been considered in judgment under review. It was also not considered whether the process of declaration as a reserve forest was complete on publication of the notice dated the 13th April, 1955.
